title: Single-module transpose under the pinned derived adjunction
statement: Choose the shared derived categories of $\mathcal O$-modules [def-pc-derived-category]. Let $f:X\to S$ be a scheme morphism [def-pc-scheme], $N$ an $\mathcal O_S$-module, $M$ an $\mathcal O_X$-module and $a:f^*N\to M$ [lem-pc-module-pullback-adjunction]. Write $p_f(N):Lf^*(N[0])\to(f^*N)[0]$ for canonicalSinglePullbackMap [lem-pc-canonical-single-pullback-comparison] and $u_f(M):(f_*M)[0]\to Rf_*(M[0])$ for canonicalSingleDirectImageMap [lem-pc-canonical-single-direct-image-comparison]. Let $A_f:Lf^*\dashv Rf_*$ be the adjunction selected by exists_schemeDerivedAdjunction using the same chosen left-derived counit as derived composition [def-pc-derived-base-change-map]. Then $A_f.\operatorname{homEquiv}(p_f(N)\circ a[0])=\operatorname{homEquiv}_{f^*\dashv f_*}(a)[0]\circ u_f(M)$, where the displayed composite follows Lean order (first $p_f$, then $a[0]$, and first the ordinary transpose, then $u_f$). No injective-resolution, flatness or vanishing hypothesis is required.

proof.text: Let ε be the chosen left-derived counit, adj the pinned tensor-pullback adjunction, and t = adj.leftAdjointUniq (pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f). Set b = t.hom.app N ≫ a. The unit law for leftAdjointUniq and homEquiv_naturality_right identify adj.homEquiv b with the ordinary transpose of a. Prove the single-complex transpose identity degreewise: at degree zero use naturality of the adjunction unit and the single-object comparison isomorphisms; away from zero the source is zero. Descend this identity through the quotient using mapHomotopyCategory_unit_app_quotient. Apply Classical.choose_spec (exists_schemeDerivedAdjunction f ε hε) to the quotient of the single-complex comparison followed by b[0]. Substitute the proved homotopy-category transpose identity, localize, and use functoriality and associativity to identify both sides with the canonical single pullback and direct-image maps. No flatness, invertibility, or nonempty-scheme hypothesis is used.
